ticks.note: Tick 1: `Working` starts in `Raising`, whose entry action asks for flashing and commands the barrier up. The lamps start in the next tick (`Lights` waits a tick in `Dark`).
No `isUp` yet: the lamps flash while the barrier is commanded up.

`restart` with the barrier down: `Working` starts in `Raising` again. `Fault`'s exit action clears `flashing`, and `Raising`'s entry action sets it again in the same tick, so the lamps keep flashing while the barrier rises.
The barrier leaves its lower limit switch.
`isUp`: now it is safe to go dark.
